name: Functional language with a specializing translator (specialator)

mentions.name: Functional language with a specializing translator (specialator)
mentions.description: A functional language paired with a specializing translator ('specialator') based on graph-reduction beneath lambdas. The specialator specializes away interpretive and meta-programming-like overhead, then translates the result into usable source code in a chosen target language — currently JS and C — yielding conventional imperative code when specialization succeeds and more functional-style code otherwise. The language features an expressive type system based on self-dependent sub-typing, intended to be used with a decidability checker. It is an experimental work-in-progress.
mentions.problem: Interpretive and meta-programming-like overhead in functional programs, which the specialator aims to specialize away before generating code.
